newsitem.title: ITALY: Berisha's daughter returns to Albania from Italy.
newsitem.headline: Berisha's daughter returns to Albania from Italy.

text.p: The daughter of Albanian President Sali Berisha returned to Tirana on Friday two weeks after leaving the country at the height of armed unrest, sources at Rome's Fiumicino airport said.
The sources said Argita Berisha and her baby daughter had boarded an Albanian Airlines flight for the capital Tirana, the first since March 13.
Argita and Berisha's son, Sokol, left Albania from the port of Durres on the last commercial ferry to Italy on March 13 after the collapse of government control in the south of the Balkan state.
News of the Berisha children's arrival in Italy angered rebels controlling southern towns.
They have demanded Berisha's resignation, blaming him for failing to warn Albanians of the risks of shady investment schemes which have collapsed with the life savings of tens of thousands of people.

The Albanian embassy in Rome was not available for comment on Argita Berisha's departure and it was not clear whether her brother was also already back in Tirana, where life has gradually returned to normal from near-anarchy.
